verdict.rationale: Codex confirms IDE integration (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf extensions) and a CLI/cloud agent that edits files, applies diffs, and can open PRs, matching the core story. However, evidence is thin on the specific in-editor multi-file edit UX (mostly CLI/cloud workflow descriptions), and community feedback raises caveats about reliability, aggressive sandboxing prompts, and inconsistent quality across contexts.
